title: A user with the dedicated Sales By Customer View permission can see and open the report
custom_preconds:
1. A test user exists whose role has the dedicated Sales By Customer report View permission (create a ZZAUTOTEST custom role if needed).
  2. You are signed in as that user.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports area.
  2. Click "Sales By Customer" in the left-side navigation.
custom_expected:
1. The "Sales By Customer" entry is visible in the Reports navigation.
  2. The report opens and shows its data.
  3. Access is granted by the dedicated Sales By Customer permission itself — the report is not tied to a generic "all reports" permission.
